answer: In the Nebula mesh, each agent identity must continuously burn 0.1 NECTAR per block as a "canyon fee" — a proof-of-burn with no refund. An attacker running N fake identities pays 0.1×N NECTAR per block, so costs scale linearly and drain endlessly, since burned tokens are irrecoverable; a single Sybil cluster of 1,000 identities incinerates 100 NECTAR per block, making sustained fake identities economically self-destructing.
